title: The FAR and Beyond: A New Era in Government Acquisition | All About the Base
transcriptText:
There has been nothing less than an
earthquake in federal acquisition and
procurement over the last 13 months.
There have been at least 59 recent
executive actions focused on the federal
government acquisition system since the
start of the second Trump
administration. Three of the most
prominent of these efforts are the
revolutionary FAR overhaul,
the consolidation of procurement
responsibility in the General Services
Administration or GSA,
and efforts to promote crossgovernment
use of coste effective commercial
solutions.
These changes focus on speed, reducing
barriers, and limiting duplication.
I recently spoke with Mr. Jeffrey Koses,
the senior procurement executive at GSA
to learn more about this work and the
role the GSA is taking to in rising to
the challenges in carrying out these
directives. Streamlining government
procurement is not an easy task, but
there is a true sense of urgency in the
current current moment. I'm your host,
Jerry McInn, and welcome to another
episode of All About the Base.
In this first clip, Jeffrey Koses
explains the two phases of changes to
the federal acquisition regulation or
FAR. Let's take a look.
